summary: Mud and dust weathering, per-vehicle stencils and bumper codes, car wheels, single-pin tracks, glass and rotor blur across the roster.
rationale: Static surface and detail changes across every family: one matched close-up sheet of eight representative vehicles shows them. The rotor blur moves and only shows in flight, so it is described in text rather than shown; in-game roster views were not repeatable between runs, so the studio stage is the controlled comparison.
